metadata.chunk_title: Online Master of Arts in English + Deepen your knowledge of English studies

facts.value: Pursuing this Master of Arts in English online from Arizona State University will provide you with opportunities to deepen your knowledge of advanced English studies. Upon graduation, you’ll be equipped to chart new career opportunities with an understanding of the historical, philosophical and cultural contexts of creative work.

facts.value: The customizable curriculum broadens your knowledge of a range of topics from traditional literary and rhetorical analysis and curriculum design to research and multimodal compositions. In addition to building core competencies in linguistics, literature, writing and English education, you’ll also choose electives that support your interests. To culminate the program, you’ll engage in a capstone experience in which you’ll synthesize and create a public-facing display of your work.

facts.value: Graduating from this program can serve your work in any artistic endeavor, discipline or profession. Whether you’re interested in editing, marketing, teaching, writing or a related field, this program will support your career aspirations. You can also use your sharpened writing and abilities as a stepping stone toward future doctorate work.
